scope: Order-of-magnitude dissipation sensitivity, not PCB thermal simulation

TPS5430.limitations: Switch transition time and actual board thermal resistance are assumptions; EVM theta cannot certify this copper layout.

XC6206.limitations: Package Pd-based estimate, not measured thermal impedance.

other_losses.limitations: Input diode dissipation depends on actual Tab5 draw and forward voltage; copper and ambient airflow require hardware temperature measurement.
